about.en: OFC (OneFootball Credits) is the token of OneFootball Club, the fan-rewards programme of the OneFootball football media app, where fans earn and spend OFC for engagement with partner clubs and brands. It has a 1 billion supply and is deployed on Base (contract 0x752C5a95d202972E124390F30a50154409d3c858) and Ethereum (contract 0x9CB7A4EF0cAE65B07362bc679a0B874041E3da53), both listed under the same token by CoinGecko and CoinMarketCap.
